purpose: for the instruction of a son of good family (kulaputraśikṣārthanimittena)
notes: The colophon gives no names and no date. 'kulaputra' is a generic term ('son of good family'), not a personal name. The closing formula 'pūrvādṛṣṭa(!) dras(ṭ)a(na) likhāmy ahaṃ' is the stock 'yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā' type of scribal disclaimer. The cataloguer gives 'aṅgatāṣṭakaṃ(!)' as the section name; it may be corrupt. The catalogue fields are empty, so nothing conflicts with them.
